posts.author: Fasadeendring
posts.text: 1. BREAKING: US directly rejects Iran's terms to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, per US officials to Yonhap. The rejected conditions were $300 billion in US compensation, all US sanctions lifted, $100 billion in frozen assets released, an end to the naval blockade, US troop withdrawal from the region, and a regional ceasefire including Lebanon and Gaza 2. BREAKING: Trump administration prepares 90-day total diesel export ban, with Trump inclined to announce it by the end of the week, per Politico. Mye mulig det blir oppgang i morgen 📈
